newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent up on back of NYMEX as upside tested.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent up on back of NYMEX as upside tested.

text.p: Brent crude futures prices settled firmer in late trading on SIMEX on Tuesday, as a strong NYMEX market encouraged a test of higher prices.
August Brent on SIMEX was last traded at $18.04 per barrel, up 18 cents from London. September was traded at $18.23, up 20.
Brokers said the move higher was built on the firmer NYMEX market on ACCESS, which has bust through New York's intraday highs.
July NYMEX crude was last traded on ACCESS at $19.24 per barrel, up 23 cents from New York and an intraday high. New York's intraday high was $19.18.
August NYMEX was last traded at $19.43, up 26 cents from New York.
Brokers said both market have broken above recent ranges and were cutting into the sharp losses posted on June 6.
They said the push could take Brent front-month crude up to $18.25 initially, and as high as $18.50.
